The day to fly abroad had finally arrived. 
However, right before departure, Vodka 
tried to act cool, only to mess up and 
sprain her leg.

With the overseas expedition completely 
scrapped, Vodka received an exasperated 
look from Daiwa Scarlet.

Daiwa Scarlet frankly expressed her 
rivalry with Vodka, saying that watching 
the Japanese Derby had lit a fire inside 
her.

To fight her, and to stage her domestic 
comeback... after a few days of rest, 
Vodka sets her sights on the "Shuka Sho" 
where her rival awaits.
